newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan interbank rate rises as reserve period ends.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan interbank rate rises as reserve period ends.

text.p: Taiwan's interbank rate closed higher on Monday due to a scarcity of operating funds in the banking system on the last day of the current monthly reserve period, dealers said.
